title: Where two 1904 streets cross, one paving wears into the next
items: Crossings no longer flicker between two pavings: at Indiana and 18th the brick and asphalt fought in blotches. Each spot now shows one roadway.
Where one paving meets another, it fades out over a few feet with a worn, ragged edge instead of a hard line.
Where each paving stops and how it wears are liberties.
